note: Your journal is private. Entries are encrypted when stored, are never shared with other people or administrators, and are never sent to the AI coach.
support_note: If writing brings up something heavy, please talk to someone you trust or a professional. If you are in danger, contact local emergency services. In the US you can call or text 988; elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists free support.

daily.label: Daily reflection
daily.description: A few lines about your day.
prompts: What stood out about today?
What went well, and what would you do differently?
What took most of your energy today?
What is one thing you want to remember from today?
What would make tomorrow a good day?

gratitude.label: Gratitude
prompts: Write down three things you are grateful for today, however small.
Who made a positive difference to your week, and how?
What is something you usually take for granted that you appreciated today?
What did you enjoy today that cost nothing?
What is a recent moment you would happily live again?

goal.label: Goal reflection
goal.description: Think about progress towards a goal.
prompts: What progress did you make towards your goal, and what helped?
What got in the way, and what could you try next time?
Is your goal still the right one? What would you adjust?
What is the smallest next step you could take?
How will you know when you have reached this goal?

development.label: Personal development
development.description: Notes on what you are learning about yourself.
prompts: What did you learn about yourself this week?
Which strength did you use recently, and how?
What is a habit you would like to build or let go of?
What feedback have you received lately, and what do you make of it?
What would you like to be better at in a year, and why?

communication.label: Communication reflection
prompts: Think of a recent conversation that went well. What did you do that helped?
Think of a conversation that was hard. What did you want the other person to understand?
When did you listen well recently, and how could you tell?
Is there something you would like to say to someone but haven't yet? What is holding you back?
How would the other person describe your last disagreement?

free.label: Free writing
prompts: What is on your mind right now?
Write for five minutes without stopping, then read it back.
What would you like to think through today?
